statement: AMD laid out a multi-year accelerator and CPU roadmap: MI500 Series GPUs in 2027, MI600 Series in 2028, Zen 7 CPUs in 2028 and Zen 8 in 2030.
why: A published annual accelerator cadence tells buyers a credible second source will keep shipping new parts, which is what makes designing around a non-incumbent supplier viable.

impact.mechanism: A committed multi-generation roadmap from a second merchant supplier adds credible alternative accelerator supply against the incumbent.

evidence.excerpt: Roadmap stated: MI500 Series GPUs in 2027; MI600 Series GPUs in 2028

confidence.basis: Vendor roadmap statement carried by a newswire; roadmaps are intentions, not shipped supply.

dispersion: conflicting same-key reports: statement/trend changed (trend rising -> rising); sources: AMD investor-relations press release, AMD press release via GlobeNewswire
